purpose: Harvest a new causally independent, price-only, high-opportunity-density entry source after SORB and PLSR failed independent/monthly robustness.
independence: No prior trade or post-exit rearm dependency.

public_logic_sources.source: TradingView ORION: Hybrid Volatility Breakout Strategy
public_logic_sources.disclosed_logic: XAUUSD M5; last-15-candle box; range height <2.5x ATR; completed candle close outside box; EMA150 direction filter; box stale after 45 bars.
public_logic_sources.role: C01/C02 mechanism source; performance claims ignored.

public_logic_sources.source: TradingView Bollinger Band Squeeze with Dotted Midlines
public_logic_sources.disclosed_logic: BB length 20 / 2.0 stddev; KC length 20 / 1.5 ATR; squeeze when BB is inside KC.
Prior closed bar squeeze; entry when price closes beyond Keltner upper/lower after squeeze; one position; spread filter.
public_logic_sources.role: C03/C04 release and breakout semantics; performance claims ignored.

public_logic_sources.disclosed_logic: Squeeze release followed in direction of momentum.
BB20/2.0 inside KC20/1.5; squeeze fires on release; 12-period momentum gives direction.
public_logic_sources.role: C04 12-bar momentum anchor; no performance claim imported.

R037-VCE-C01_ORION_M5_BOX15.breakout: first later completed M5 close outside frozen box

R037-VCE-C02_ORION_M5_BOX15_EMA150.breakout: first later completed M5 close outside frozen box
R037-VCE-C02_ORION_M5_BOX15_EMA150.trend_filter: long close > EMA150; short close < EMA150

R037-VCE-C03_BBKC_RELEASE.squeeze: prior bar BB20 SMA +/-2.0 stddev fully inside KC EMA20 +/-1.5 ATR20
R037-VCE-C03_BBKC_RELEASE.breakout: current completed close beyond current KC outer band

R037-VCE-C04_BBKC_RELEASE_MOM12.squeeze: prior bar BB20 SMA +/-2.0 stddev fully inside KC EMA20 +/-1.5 ATR20
R037-VCE-C04_BBKC_RELEASE_MOM12.breakout: current completed close beyond current KC outer band
R037-VCE-C04_BBKC_RELEASE_MOM12.momentum_filter: 12-bar close displacement must agree with breakout

execution.proposal_entry: first executable tick at/after completed signal bar right edge

screen_gate.reuse: Frozen R037 independent-source Stage-A screen from SORB/PLSR.
screen_gate.winner_or_quality_gate: official-win delta nonnegative OR positive net with improved gross loss

selection: Only preregistered configs may survive. Rank strong screen first, then screen pass, net delta, official-win delta, accepted entries. No post-result parameter changes.
